content: If SOMEIPTransformationProps . sizeOfAr- rayLengthField is present for a static size array the data type for the length field of the array shall be determined by the value of SOMEIPTransformation- Props . sizeOfArrayLengthField : • uint8 if sizeOfArrayLengthField equals 1 • uint16 if sizeOfArrayLengthField equals 2 • uint32 if sizeOfArrayLengthField equals 4 • Otherwise [SWS_SomeIpXf_00221] applies.
